cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Test the Story First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to repeat the explanation, ask the dangerous question, or test the risky step before you commit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've stepped back from Dad's door, so I have too. Give him space. Ask whether he's angry about the flight cost before I go in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stepped back to let you through. You booked them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Plenty of room, yes. You ask about the price first; I'll follow if he's calm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If he wants the receipt, I'm calling you in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask whether he needs the total or each charge. I need a minute before we get to the seat upgrades.
